definitions.gloss: convenience store payment; paying bills at a convenience store
definitions.explanation: A payment method where bills, online shopping orders, or other charges are paid in cash at a convenience store counter using a payment slip or barcode.

examples.japanese: コンビニ{払|ばら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
⟦ネットショッピング→ネットショッピング：29757_nettoshoppingu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支払|しはら}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧コンビニ{払|ばら}いにした。
examples.english: I chose convenience store payment for the online shopping purchase.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電気|でんき}{代|だい}→電気代：09543_denkidai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧コンビニ{払|ばら}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{済|す}ませた→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I took care of the electricity bill through convenience store payment.

notes:
A uniquely Japanese payment method that allows customers to pay for purchases, utility bills, and other charges at convenience stores. Very common in Japan, where convenience stores (⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧) serve as multi-purpose service points. Particularly useful for people without credit cards.

HOW IT WORKS:
When shopping online or receiving a bill, select コンビニ{払|ばら}い as the payment method. You receive a payment slip or barcode (by email or print), take it to any convenience store, and pay in cash at the register.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コンビニ{払|ばら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to select convenience store payment
- コンビニ{払|ばら}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧: to pay via convenience store payment
- コンビニ{払|ばら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧: payment deadline for convenience store payment

OTHER PAYMENT METHODS:
- ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}{振込|ふりこみ}→銀行振込：25648_ginkoufurikomi⟧: bank transfer
- ⟦クレジットカード→クレジットカード：06968_kurejittokaado⟧⟦{払|ばら}い→払い：09655_barai⟧: credit card payment
- ⟦{代金|だいきん}{引換|ひきかえ}→代金引換：28163_daikinhikikae⟧: cash on delivery
- ⟦{口座|こうざ}{振替|ふりかえ}→口座振替：19853_kouzafurikae⟧: automatic bank debit
